source: User listening reports and bounded ALSA/Android comparisons on 2026-10-27

issues.description: 2026-11-02仅恢复SDM845停流前静音，保留原WSA881x。跟踪证实原prepare重建SoundWire时PA仍开启；修改后两侧先静音、断流、重建再解除静音。重启后用户确认单次、间隔10秒两遍及原应用暂停/恢复均正常。组合PRE_PMD版本仍排除；长期声学表现未认证。

视频整体偏小、薄。raw75 (-9 dB) 相比72更清楚但仍偏小且无新增杂音。160 Hz 对照：单左/单右很微弱，同相双侧较明显，反相居中；用户强调全部仍非常微弱。250 Hz 相位对照差异不明确。暂无依据反转系统声道，也未测定基频/谐波或真实截止频率。Android MUSIC 15/15、master1、balance0、0 effect chains，RX INT7/8 HPF0.48Hz。

User reported intermittent internal-speaker breakage/frame stalls on Bili switch/seek, reproduced under bounded read-only capture, then explicitly confirmed listening recovered this round. v18 fixes a proven Venus FLUSH/SEQ_CHANGED lock dependency; audio HAL774cd7e7 remains unchanged. One4096-frame output skip and one PCM XRUN were independently observed at different times; no claim all audio transport causes are eliminated.

PCM cannot prepare: cached write capacity 0 while 16 passive capability reads report actual depth16. Service restart and slave runtime cycle ineffective. Candidate serializes WCD AHB transactions and reads valid immutable capacity before IRQ registration. No guessed capacity or provider hot reset.
issues.validation: persistent v21: cached FIFO16 matches hardware; two192000-frame plays drain, real PCM pointers advance, zero XRUN; user confirms Bilibili built-in sound normal after normal reboot

instruction: 继续音频定位；不盲目提高低频或 PA 增益，不关闭 DAC/COMP/BOOST 配对端口。真正休眠仍暂停。
volume_experiment: 2026-10-27: live RX7/RX8 raw 75 (-9 dB), PA unchanged and pmdown_time=0. User reports clearer but still quiet, no new distortion. Startup route remains raw 72; higher gain not yet persisted. Prepared 250/160 Hz L, R, same-polarity and inverted-polarity probe; system polarity unchanged.
